```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "here",
  "psych",        # alpha(), omega(), describe()
  "knitr", "kableExtra"
)

options(knitr.table.format = "html", scipen = 999)

proj_path <- here()
quest_path <- file.path(proj_path, "data", "SOS_questionnaire_data.csv")
```

```{r load-data}
quest_raw <- read.csv(quest_path) |>
  rename(SampleID = SID) |>
  mutate(across(-SampleID, \(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))))

cat("N participants:", nrow(quest_raw), "\n")
```

---

# CES-DC

**Center for Epidemiological Studies Depression Scale for Children** (Weissman et al., 1980).
20 items, 0–3 scale. Items 4, 8, 12, 16 are positively worded and reverse-scored (3 – item).
Total range 0–60; clinical cutoff ≥ 15.

```{r cesdc-score}
cesdc_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, starts_with("CES_DC_")) |>
  mutate(
    CES_DC_4  = 3 - CES_DC_4,
    CES_DC_8  = 3 - CES_DC_8,
    CES_DC_12 = 3 - CES_DC_12,
    CES_DC_16 = 3 - CES_DC_16
  )

cesdc_mat <- cesdc_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

cesdc_scores <- cesdc_items |>
  mutate(CESDC_total = rowSums(cesdc_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, CESDC_total)
```

## Item descriptives

```{r cesdc-item-desc}
describe(cesdc_mat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC item descriptives (after reverse-scoring)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Internal consistency

```{r cesdc-alpha}
cesdc_alpha <- alpha(cesdc_mat, check.keys = FALSE)
print(cesdc_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r cesdc-alpha-tbl}
tibble(
  Statistic = c("α (raw)", "α (std.)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper",
                "Mean inter-item r", "Median inter-item r"),
  Value = c(
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$raw_alpha,  3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$std.alpha,  3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$feldt$lower.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$feldt$upper.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$average_r,   3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$median_r,    3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC internal consistency") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r cesdc-omega}
cesdc_omega <- omega(cesdc_mat, nfactors = 1, plot = FALSE)
tibble(
  Statistic = c("ω (total)", "ω (hierarchical)", "α"),
  Value = c(
    round(cesdc_omega$omega.tot, 3),
    round(cesdc_omega$omega_h,   3),
    round(cesdc_omega$alpha,     3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC omega reliability") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Item-total correlations

```{r cesdc-item-total}
cesdc_alpha$item.stats |>
  select(r.cor, r.drop) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(`r (corrected item-total)` = r.cor,
         `r (α if item dropped)`   = r.drop) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC item-total correlations") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Total score descriptives

```{r cesdc-total-desc}
describe(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC total score (0–60; cutoff ≥ 15)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)

cat("N above cutoff (≥ 15):",
    sum(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total >= 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)", 100 * mean(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total >= 15, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
```

# Puberty

## Pubertal Development Scale (PDS)

**Petersen et al. (1988), female version.** Four somatic development items (F1 growth spurt,
F2 body hair, F3 skin changes, F4 breast development) rated 1–4 (1 = no development,
4 = development seems complete). Item F6 = menarche (0 = no → scored 1; 1 = yes → scored 4)
and is included in the mean score. **Item F5 (perceived timing relative to peers) is excluded
from the developmental mean** and treated separately as a timing operationalisation (see below).
Items F7–F10 capture menarche date (free-text) and are excluded.

PDS developmental mean = mean of F1, F2, F3, F4, F6_recoded (range 1–4).

```{r pds-score}
pds_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_F1, PDS_F2, PDS_F3, PDS_F4, PDS_F5, PDS_F6) |>
  mutate(PDS_F6_coded = if_else(PDS_F6 == 1, 4L, 1L))  # yes=4, no=1

# Developmental scale: F1, F2, F3, F4, F6_coded (excludes F5 perceived timing)
pds_mat <- pds_items |>
  select(PDS_F1, PDS_F2, PDS_F3, PDS_F4, PDS_F6_coded) |>
  as.matrix()

pds_scores <- pds_items |>
  mutate(PDS_mean = rowMeans(pds_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_mean, PDS_F5)   # retain F5 for timing analyses
```

### Item descriptives (F1–F4 + recoded F6)

```{r pds-item-desc}
describe(pds_mat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS developmental items: F1–F4 + F6 recoded (1 = no development / no menarche, 4 = complete / menarche)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)

cat("Menarche: yes =", sum(pds_items$PDS_F6 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ", no =", sum(pds_items$PDS_F6 == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

### PDS_F5: Perceived timing

```{r pds-f5-desc}
describe(pds_items$PDS_F5) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS F5: perceived timing relative to peers (1 = much earlier, 4 = much later)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Internal consistency (F1–F4 + recoded F6)

```{r pds-alpha}
pds_alpha <- alpha(pds_mat, check.keys = TRUE)
print(pds_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r pds-alpha-tbl}
tibble(
  Statistic = c("α (raw)", "α (std.)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper",
                "Mean inter-item r"),
  Value = c(
    round(pds_alpha$total$raw_alpha,   3),
    round(pds_alpha$total$std.alpha,   3),
    round(pds_alpha$feldt$lower.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pds_alpha$feldt$upper.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pds_alpha$total$average_r,   3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS internal consistency (F1–F4 + recoded F6)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r pds-omega}
pds_omega <- omega(pds_mat, nfactors = 1, plot = FALSE)
tibble(
  Statistic = c("ω (total)", "ω (hierarchical)", "α"),
  Value = c(
    round(pds_omega$omega.tot, 3),
    round(pds_omega$omega_h,   3),
    round(pds_omega$alpha,     3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS omega reliability (F1–F4 + recoded F6)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Item-total correlations (F1–F4 + recoded F6)

```{r pds-item-total}
pds_alpha$item.stats |>
  select(r.cor, r.drop) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(`r (corrected item-total)` = r.cor,
         `r (α if item dropped)`   = r.drop) |>

```

### Total score descriptives

```{r pds-total-desc}

  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS developmental mean (F1–F4 + recoded F6; range 1–4)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Picture Based Interview about Puberty (PBIP)

**Picture Based Interview about Puberty** (PBIP; Koff & Rierdan, 1995). 2 items used (1A, 2A —
items assessing perceived breast and pubic hair development), rated 2–5. Items 1B and 2B
(body size / shape) are excluded. Higher scores indicate more advanced perceived pubertal development.

```{r pbip-score}
pbip_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PBIP_1A, PBIP_2A)

pbip_mat <- pbip_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

pbip_scores <- pbip_items |>
  mutate(PBIP_mean = rowMeans(pbip_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, PBIP_mean)
```

### Item descriptives

```{r pbip-item-desc}
describe(pbip_mat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PBIP item descriptives — 1A and 2A only (2–5)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Internal consistency

```{r pbip-alpha}
pbip_alpha <- alpha(pbip_mat, check.keys = TRUE)
print(pbip_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r pbip-alpha-tbl}
tibble(
  Statistic = c("α (raw)", "α (std.)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper",
                "Mean inter-item r"),
  Value = c(
    round(pbip_alpha$total$raw_alpha,   3),
    round(pbip_alpha$total$std.alpha,   3),
    round(pbip_alpha$feldt$lower.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pbip_alpha$feldt$upper.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pbip_alpha$total$average_r,   3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "PBIP internal consistency (items 1A and 2A)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r pbip-omega}
# omega requires ≥ 3 items; report inter-item r only for 2-item scale
cat("Note: omega requires ≥ 3 items. For this 2-item scale, inter-item r =",
    round(cor(pbip_mat[complete.cases(pbip_mat), ])[1, 2], 3),
    "is the appropriate reliability index.\n")
```

### Item-total correlations

```{r pbip-item-total}
pbip_alpha$item.stats |>
  select(r.cor, r.drop) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(`r (corrected item-total)` = r.cor,
         `r (α if item dropped)`   = r.drop) |>
  kable(caption = "PBIP item-total correlations") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```


# BFNES

**Brief Fear of Negative Evaluation Scale** (Leary, 1983). 12 items, 1–5 scale.
Items 2, 4, and 7 are reverse-scored (6 – item). Item 10 is stored in the forward
direction in the raw data (item-total *r* = +.60 without reversal) and is not
reverse-scored. Sum total range 12–60; higher scores indicate greater fear of
negative evaluation.

```{r bfnes-score}
bfnes_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, starts_with("BFNES_")) |>
  mutate(
    BFNES_2 = 6 - BFNES_2,
    BFNES_4 = 6 - BFNES_4,
    BFNES_7 = 6 - BFNES_7
    # BFNES_10 forward-scored in raw data; reversal confirmed incorrect empirically
  )

bfnes_mat <- bfnes_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

bfnes_scores <- bfnes_items |>
  mutate(BFNES_total = rowSums(bfnes_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, BFNES_total)
```

## Item descriptives

```{r bfnes-item-desc}
  kable(caption = "BFNES item descriptives (after reverse-scoring; 1–5)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r bfnes-alpha-tbl}
) |>

```

# Scored totals summary

```{r all-totals}
list(cesdc_scores, pds_scores, pbip_scores, bfnes_scores) |>
  reduce(full_join, by = "SampleID") |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  describe() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "All scale totals — descriptive summary") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```
